Author: Rhiani
Name: Glamour Tagger
Description:
Designed to help you tag, flag, organize and filter items effortlessly to preview them, bridging the gap between massive item databases, your installed mods, and your glamours. 

- Create custom tags, manage those tags, flag items between 5 different categories 
- See exactly which Penumbra mods affect any item directly in your list 
- Filter them by your tags, flags, mods and other attributes 
- Preview them one by one or cycle through them on your character or in the fitting room 

Standalone can be used; however, it's best with Glamourer and Penumbra:
Prerequisites for preview on character: Glamourer
Prerequisites for mod listings and filters: Penumbra
Punchline: Tag, flag, filter, then preview items for your glamours.
